agents.name: Claude Code
agents.summary: Adds long-term memory to Claude Code across projects and sessions. Install once; recall and capture run automatically.

agents.name: Codex
agents.summary: Adds persistent cross-session memory to Codex through lifecycle hooks and the OpenViking MCP endpoint.

agents.name: Doubao Work
agents.summary: Connect through the built-in connector to give Doubao Work persistent context memory, with automatic recall and capture during conversations.

agents.name: WorkBuddy
agents.summary: Use MCP tools in WorkBuddy for memory recall and storage, knowledge resource management, and code context retrieval.

agents.name: TRAE
agents.summary: Add automatic prompt recall and turn capture to TRAE and TRAE CN through native hooks plus MCP tools.

agents.name: Cursor
agents.summary: One command installs Cursor lifecycle hooks, MCP tools, rules, and skills for automatic memory recall and capture.

agents.name: OpenClaw
agents.summary: Plugin integration for OpenClaw as a context engine, with cross-agent memory and one-command setup through the npm helper.

agents.name: Hermes Agent
agents.summary: Hermes includes OpenViking as a native memory provider. Run hermes memory setup openviking, keep VolcEngine Cloud, and paste the API key.

agents.name: OpenCode
agents.summary: Provides one unified OpenCode plugin for repository context, memory tools, session sync, and automatic recall.

agents.name: DeepSeek Harness
agents.summary: Give DeepSeek Harness long-term memory across projects and sessions, with automatic recall, capture, OpenViking tools, and the openviking-memory skill.

agents.name: DeerFlow
agents.summary: DeerFlow can connect through MemoryManager and MCP to automatically write, recall, inject, and manage memory. Enable both methods for the full memory experience.
